headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2021: Hikaru Shida vs. Ryo Mizunami went to battle over the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.08 ? a real highlight of the night. It was the first title opportunity of Ryo Mizunami's career. A grudge match capping years of previous three-way draws between the two ? Mizunami had personally guaranteed Shida wouldn't beat her "even in 100 years," but the champion proved her wrong with a hard-earned corkscrew knee finish in a match many called a career-best outing for both.
Back on this day in 2026, Lena Kross made their AEW debut, appearing on Collision, rated 6.97.

Turning the clock back to 2021: AEW welcomed Sting for the first time in a Street Fight match against Allin & Team Taz (Cage & Starks), appearing on Revolution, rated 7.81 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Sting's first in-ring match in over five years since his forced retirement, teaming with Darby Allin in a cinematic street fight ? a career comeback nobody thought they'd see, and one Sting himself later said meant more to him than Allin ever realized.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2021, when Kenny Omega vs. Jon Moxley clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title in an Exploding Barbed Wire Death match, appearing on Revolution, rated 7.63 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
Back on this day in 2021, Colten Gunn arrived in AEW in a Casino Battle Royale match, appearing on Revolution, rated 6.05.
Back on this day in 2026, Konosuke Takeshita vs. Claudio Castagnoli headlined Collision, rated 7.86 ? a strong outing.
